name: Contactor
summary: An electrically operated switching device commonly used for repeated switching duties.
description: A contactor uses an operating mechanism to switch its main contacts and may include auxiliary contacts for control or indication. On a power drawing it represents the main switching path; on a schematic its coil and contacts may be distributed and connected by identifiers.

Its ability to switch a particular load depends on the selected device and utilization category. Overload or short-circuit protection can be provided by other devices in the arrangement. Do not treat the generic contactor representation as a complete protective device.
readingNotes: Distinguish main power poles from auxiliary control contacts.
Use the common equipment identifier to connect the power and control drawings.
drawingChecklist: Reference the load duty and contactor specification.
Show the coil supply and associated contacts.
Identify separate protective equipment where applicable.
distinction: A contactor and circuit breaker have different duties. Adding an overload relay does not make every contactor assembly equivalent to a circuit breaker.
